find src tests bin -type f | head -30; echo "---"; cat package.json
node -e "
import('./src/paginate.js').then(({paginate}) => {
  const items = Array.from({length: 20}, (_, i) => i + 1);
  const pages = paginate(items, 20);
  console.log('pages count:', pages.length);
  pages.forEach((p, i) => console.log('page', i + 1, '->', p.length, 'items'));
  console.log('empty-input:', JSON.stringify(paginate([], 10)));
  console.log('5 items / pageSize 10:', JSON.stringify(paginate([1,2,3,4,5], 10).map(p => p.length)));
});
"
node --test tests/ 2>&1 | tail -12

node --test tests/suite.test.mjs 2>&1 | grep -E "^(not ok|ok|# (tests|pass|fail))"; echo "--- direct repro ---"; node -e "
import('./src/paginate.js').then(({paginate}) => {
  const items = Array.from({length: 20}, (_, i) => i + 1);
  const p20 = paginate(items, 20);
  console.log('20/20 -> pages:', p20.length, 'all non-empty:', p20.every(p => p.length > 0));
  console.log('0/10 ->', JSON.stringify(paginate([], 10)));
  console.log('5/10 -> pages:', paginate([1,2,3,4,5], 10).length);
  console.log('41/20 -> pages:', paginate(Array.from({length:41},(_,i)=>i), 20).length, '(expect 3)');
});
"
git diff 2>&1
